text:
Residents:
Yuki (early 50s) works from home. Weekdays: at desk in bedroom_1 from 9:00 to ~17:30. May leave for lunch. Weekends: sleeps in, errands midday, home otherwise. Hobbies: friends, gym, running.
Nora (40s) works in town. Weekdays: out 8:00–17:30. Weekends: sleeps in, errands midday, home otherwise. Hobbies: napping, reading, sketching. Cares for the dog. Note: Nora was home sick on Thursday. On Friday, she left the house around 16:00 and returned around 20:14, despite the standard work schedule.

Object Locations & Movement:
Most items are static. Key movable items:
- laptop_yuki, charger_yuki, pen_yuki: Usually on desk_b1 during work hours (9:00–17:30 weekdays). May move to couch_l1 or armchair_l1 in evenings.
- tablet_yuki: On nightstand_b1. May move to kitchen_table_k1 for casual use.
- book_yuki: On nightstand_b1.
- gym_bag_yuki: In wardrobe_b1. Taken out for gym sessions.
- running_shoes_yuki: On shoe_rack_e1. Taken out for running.
- jacket_yuki, hat_yuki, scarf_yuki, umbrella_yuki, shoes_yuki: On entry_hook_e1. Taken out when Yuki leaves the house.
- keys_yuki, wallet_yuki: On entry_table_e1. Taken out when Yuki leaves.
- sketchbook_nora, pencil_case_nora: On desk_b2. Used for sketching at home.
- book_nora: On nightstand_b2. May move to armchair_l1 or coffee_table_l1 for reading.
- laptop_nora: On nightstand_b2. Taken out of the house when Nora leaves for work or errands.
- skincare_nora, toiletry_bag_nora, razor_nora: In bathroom. Used daily.
- towel_nora: On towel_rack_ba1. May move to bathroom_shelf_ba1.
- dog_leash_shared: On entry_hook_e1. Taken out for walks.
- dog_bowl_shared, dog_food_bag_shared, dog_toy_shared: Dog items. Bowl/food used for feeding.
- vacuum_cleaner_shared: On entry_floor_e1. Used for cleaning.
- shopping_bag_shared: In pantry_shelf_k1. Likely contains groceries.
- snack_bowl_shared, fruit_bowl_shared: On kitchen_table_k1. Consumed and refilled.
- mug_yuki: In sink_k1 or cupboard_k1. Used in morning, then washed. May move to desk_b1.
- blanket_shared, cushions: On couch_l1/armchair_l1. May move to coffee_table_l1 or bed_b1.
- remote_shared: On tv_stand_l1. Used for TV.
- speaker_shared: On bookshelf_l1. Used for audio.
- board_game_shared: On bookshelf_l1. May move to coffee_table_l1 for play.
- vase_shared, picture_frame_shared: On bookshelf_l1. Decorative.
- candle_shared, coasters_shared: On coffee_table_l1. Used for drinks/decor.
- lamp_shared: On side_table_l1. Used for light.
- kettle_shared, cutting_board_shared, pan_shared, pot_shared, kitchen_knife_shared, spatula_shared: In kitchen. Used for cooking.
- bowl_nora, glass_nora, mug_nora, plate_nora, bowl_yuki, glass_yuki, plate_yuki: In cupboard_k1. Used for eating/drinking.
- laundry_basket_shared: On bathroom_shelf_ba1. Used for laundry.
- soap_dispenser_shared, toothbrush_holder_shared: On sink_ba_ba1. Used daily.
- towel_yuki: On towel_rack_ba1. Used daily.
- doormat_shared: On entry_floor_e1. Static.
